frozen_by: A1 controller at P4, BEFORE any PnL exists and BEFORE A7 prelaunch

windows.BTC_H1: 2020-01-01T00:00Z -> last complete hour of retrieved data (58,968 hourly bars; data_end per L1 manifest)
windows.BTC_H4: 2020-01-01 -> data end (14,742 complete H4 buckets; aggregated from the same 1h Vision series; L2 manifest)
windows.SPY_D1: 2015-01-02 -> 2026-09-16, 2,943 sessions, frozen snapshot sha 3fd229f9...; post-warmup from 2015-11-13 (L3)

folds: exact per-cell boundaries are FROZEN in each lane's era_fold_freeze.json (paths in eligible_candidates_freeze.json lane_refs); 4 contiguous outer folds per cell, fold ends force-flat, era-aligned; folds are NOT re-derived at scoring time
phase_labels: per-cell frozen PIT rules only (lane phase_rule_freeze.json); Jev labels never read; decision at bar/session close, first executable fill at next bar/open; warmup excluded everywhere

arms.candidates: the 4 arms in eligible_candidates_freeze.json — each trades ONLY while its frozen phase state is active on its cell, else FLAT

baselines_reference_not_budget.ALWAYS_ON_LONG: long from first post-warmup bar to window end, re-entered at each fold start; BTC perp long, SPY long
baselines_reference_not_budget.ALWAYS_ON_TREND_LF: long iff close > SMA200 of the cell clock (200xH1, 200xH4, 200 sessions), else flat
baselines_reference_not_budget.SPARSE_RISK_OFF: long unless trailing drawdown from running window high > 30% (BTC) / > 20% (SPY); re-entry when drawdown <= 10%; min-hold 5 bars; round frozen constants

arms.controls: each candidate's ONE preregistered falsification control, semantics exactly as frozen in its proposal (phase-shuffled matched with movement validation / clock-only / neighbour); control out-earning the candidate = kill (G6); invalid control null = disclosed, gates rest on G1-G5

costs.BTC_H1|BTC_H4: taker 5 bps/side + slippage 1 bps/side (6 bps/side; 12 bps round trip); funding 1.377e-5 per 8h signed by position (perp)
costs.SPY_D1: 10 bps per fill long-only (20 bps round trip); no financing
costs.tiers: 1.0x / 1.5x / 2.0x multiplier on the FULL cost stack (fees+slippage+funding); zero-cost variants diagnostic-only, never support a PASS

churn_law: candidates inherit their frozen min-dwell + no-op law; unnecessary_close_reopen must be structurally zero (counter reported); candidate FAILS the cell if its position-switch count implies churn not bounded by its frozen law
spy_calendar_gate: plan §10 regressions (weekday-rotation invariance + Tuesday test) RE-RUN at integration (PASS: 55/55 L3 tests) and re-run inside the scored run; any weekday-attributable force-flat = BLOCKED_SPY_CALENDAR_DEFECT, scoring halted
scored_run_ingest_verification: A7-M3 remediation, BINDING: immediately before the scored run, re-hash EVERY file in the BTC manifests (L1: 102 entries; L2: 182 entries incl. the 4h shadow) against raw bytes re-staged from data.binance.vision, and re-verify the SPY snapshot sha 3fd229f9... — ANY drift = BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION, zero cells scored, GO consumed-disclosed. Digest verification is a scheduled scored-run precondition, not prose.

gates_per_candidate.G3: net (1.0x) beats ALL FOUR baselines on the same cell
gates_per_candidate.G4: positive in >=3/4 folds OR best-fold-removed net > 0
gates_per_candidate.G5: no single fold contributes > 50% of positive net
gates_per_candidate.G6: preregistered control does not out-earn the candidate
gates_per_candidate.G7: turnover within frozen ceiling; zero unnecessary close-reopen
gates_per_candidate.G8: reproduction byte-match (detached twin at exact freeze)

scoring_run_law: ONE atomic process under the machine-wide heavy lock AFTER owner GO; ALL 4 candidates + 4 baselines + controls across ALL 3 cells in the same run; full denominator (no mid-run stopping on ugly numbers); no rule/parameter edit after any PnL is visible; reporting per cell x phase x era: trades, gross, fees, slippage, funding, net, drawdown, fold concentration, holding time vs baselines; NOT_RUN separated from FAIL everywhere
trial_identity: cycle_id PHASE-STRATEGY-V1 + arm_id + arm_config_digest + data manifest digest + code_freeze_sha + cost_tier + fold contract, recorded per scored arm; observed vs published denominators reported at every checkpoint
contamination: S0 discovery everywhere; BTC 2020-2024 = DISCOVERY_ON_NEVER_COMPUTED_HISTORY; never OOS; no shadow/paper/live/orders; S1 SEALED_UNTOUCHED
go_phrase: GO PHASE STRATEGY V1 SCORED EXECUTION (typed by the owner at STOP-1 only; this freeze consumes nothing)
